JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 2 · To the Moon

In Earth orbit, helmets off. Two orbits, then the third stage fires again and sends you towards the Moon. The Command Module Pilot turns the spacecraft round, docks with the Lunar Module and pulls it free; then three days of coasting while the Earth shrinks behind you. Sit down in a chair before you start.

In the headset: A or X runs time faster (×10, ×100, ×1000, ×10,000; never across the burn or the docking), Y the big window to your left, hold B to look from outside, right stick press to sit right again.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, W faster, C window, O outside, 1–6 jump.
